content.text:
A single 8-second cinematic historical live-action scene, 16:9. Han-era China. Real human actors, natural skin, low saturation gray linen and brown wood, readable shadows. No painting texture. The camera is a person's eyes, no reverse shot, no body/face/shoulder of the camera owner. Use the supplied first frame as the exact same man, pose and tent. Continue this one camera position; do not cut to a portrait or empty room.
苟安保持参考脸、黑巾、灰麻衣，杖伤后伏卧在右侧低木榻上。伤帐位置不变，旧甲挂在榻后。不要绷带、血伤，不站起。
我的眼睛在苟安榻侧停稳，安静中近景。苟安目光看向镜头位置，轻微自然呼吸，嘴唇保持完全闭合，不能说话或张嘴。他不伸手。画面没有我的手，没有拿信或递物动作。不添加任何对话、旁白、心声、叹词。Only silent human presence and natural room ambience.
自然声音：布料摩擦；实际走路才有脚步；实际接触才有纸、木响。苟安中年男声，中低略粗但清楚、克制；李严较年长，低稳。No BGM. No music, score, singing, chant or rhythmic music. NO SUBTITLES, CAPTIONS, TEXT, TITLES, LOGOS OR WATERMARKS. 不出现任何文字。不要朗读画面描述。
